scoring_implementation: R/pdf_png300_scoring.R pp_session; unchanged definitions; plus manuscript/PDF_VS_PNG300/prepare_se_estimands.py precision outcomes

primary_contrasts.name: marks_vector
primary_contrasts.hypothesis: rises from the output-rounding floor to the order of 0.07 pp; event counts no longer exact

primary_contrasts.name: compression_100
primary_contrasts.hypothesis: positive; compression adds error beyond resolution

difference_direction: positive means the new condition has larger error
estimate: mean within each of four scenarios, then equal mean of those four means among complete pairs

bootstrap.sampling: eight of the assigned eight dataset indices with replacement within each scenario
bootstrap.rng: numpy PCG64 (Python implementation) or R Mersenne-Twister if the frozen R scorer wrapper is extended; the choice is recorded with the results
bootstrap.shared_indices_across: all contrasts, metrics and descriptive scopes
bootstrap.undefined_draws: report count and leave interval unavailable
bootstrap.degenerate_draws: flag degenerate interval rather than claim precision

missingness: all 160 assignments in completion denominator; missing TAAE is NA; conditional complete-pair estimate plus observed-range fills and [0,1] bounds; pre-startup and transport recoveries handled as in the second cohort
deviations: retain scorable outputs; report revision-limit exceedances, failed checks, late assumptions and replay status by condition
extraction_audit: classify saved programs by coordinate source for every complete run, by condition
comparison_scope: post-review follow-up with historical original primary results; batch and time effects remain possible
